At month end, if at least 25 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 500 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 500. If fewer than 25 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month. For example, if everyone takes10, 250 remain and next stock is500 under either outcome. Public discussion occurs before this month's private choice. Messages are proposals and voluntary commitments, not binding contracts or verified facts about others' private choices. Catches are revealed afterward. Future cooperation is not enforced.

The ten designated opening speakers have the same speaking opportunities in every run. Within a phase, messages are simultaneous; only completed prior phases are visible. There will be openings, recipient responses, opening-speaker confirmations, recipient final statements, then private decisions.
